subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and staged evidence share plan
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report and questions

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We are validating vendors for our upcoming patient-data integration and need the following to move Redwood through our security review:

- SOC 2 Type II report covering at least the last 12 months (or a bridge letter if report period doesn't align)
- Bridge letter confirming continuous controls coverage for the audit window, if applicable
- CAIQ or SIG questionnaire responses (high level is fine for now)
- Preferred secure transfer method (S3 presigned, SharePoint link, or secure portal)

Can you confirm what you can share immediately and any expected timing? Also please include a contact for legal/procurement so we can route contract questions.

Appreciate it,
Jane
Jane Doe
Security Manager, Acme Health
(jane.doe@acmehealth.com)
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report and questions

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary of what we can provide and next steps: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: We can share the most recent Type II report for the period ending 2026-12-31. If that window doesn't cover your required dates, we can provide a bridge letter that states control continuity through the requested window.

2) Bridge letter: Draft attached (SOC2-TypeII-Bridge-Letter-DRAFT.pdf). We often iterate with customer legal on wording; we can provide a redline turn-around within 48 business hours once we have their comments.

3) CAIQ / SIG: We maintain a CAIQ mapping and a pre-populated SIG lite that covers our control posture; I can attach the CAIQ export or provide a short Q&A for items you flag.

4) Transfer options: preferred is a pre-signed S3 bucket link (expires in 7 days) or we can use our secure Drive link. We will not share reports over normal email.

5) Contacts: procurement@redwood.ai handles contracts; security@redwood.ai handles technical evidence questions. 

Proposed timeline:
- Today: Share draft bridge letter + evidence index (attached: evidence-index.csv)
- Tue 3/30: Provide CAIQ export and secure link to report
- Wed 3/31+: iterate on any redlines or outstanding QA

If that works I'll queue a small intake ticket with Security/Legal and share the secure link when ready. One more ask — can you share any targeted control areas (e.g., encryption, logging/retention, vendor access) so we prioritize the index?

Thanks,

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0123
Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Bridge-Letter-DRAFT.pdf (pdf), evidence-index.csv (csv)

Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report and questions (internal)

Stephanie / Marissa —

Saw the ask from Acme. Quick internal notes:
- Legal will want to review the bridge letter; suggest we send as "DRAFT for review" and highlight the audit period language.
- We should not include raw logs in the initial share; provide sampled telemetry + retention policy snippets instead.
- For CAIQ: R&D can export the mapped answers; Ops should pre-populate the few items around key management and encryption.

I'll put a ticket into security with priority P2 to prepare the CAIQ export and the secure S3 share. Marissa — can you own the redline turn-around if they send edits?

Thanks,
Rishi
Principal, Compliance Programs

- Share the CAIQ export (PDF) + SIG-lite mapping.
